lines: Ten builders are 23 minutes in. Every picture so far is a starting point or a measurement, none is finished work.
The ground inside the globe now follows the approved picture: a mound that rises toward the back and falls to the front glass, with the cottage, lamp, tree and pond placed where the picture has them.
The measuring and critic pack tools ran clean on the stand-ins as a dry run. No critic saw it and it is not a round.
Next: the builders' first real parts, and the cameras fitted again to the new ground.
phase 3: 1.93 h used of its 11.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 8.54 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: The base's profile measured from the approved image and drawn back onto it as rings. The model is being built to these numbers.
Bark sheet, take 1, made from a crop of the approved trunk. Not yet on the model.
Needle sheet, take 1, made from a crop of the approved crown. Not yet on the model.
Approved image above, the build below before the village work. Every part in the build is still a stand-in.
